name: Figma
verdict_reason: Penpot is the real thing — components, prototyping, dev handoff, SVG-native. For solo work and internal tools it's a clean yes. What keeps this at KINDA is everyone else: client files, plugins, and the fact that design collaboration happens where the other designers are.
what_you_lose: Figma's plugin ecosystem and multiplayer ubiquity
Auto-layout parity is close but not identical — test your patterns
